name: Swap A For B ~Onii-chan wa Imouto ni Narisumashi Josou Shite Joshikou e!!~
original_name: すわっぷAふぉ～B ～お兄ちゃんは妹になりすまし女装して女子校へ!!～
source:
Twin brother and sister have been confused since the childhood. Brother suddenly gets directed to a girls school. When he discovers the truth it's too late already - it's time to have fun.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一对双胞胎兄妹从小就经常被搞混。哥哥突然被安排到了一所女校。当他发现真相时已经太迟了——是时候好好享受了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
